snippet.title: Rise of the Spellbaker | Announcement Trailer (US)
snippet.description:
Rise of the Spellbaker releases 2027 on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation®5. Add it to your wish list now!
PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607400/Rise_of_the_Spellbaker/?link_type=btn
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/rise-of-the-spellbaker/9ncqw71zwjln?link_type=btn
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014998?link_type=btn

In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, our Witch seemingly finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land. Fight back the insatiable Rot by awakening the powerful magic of spellbaking from forgotten recipes and uncover the hidden hand that pulling the strings behind this foul fate. 


*** 

Kalypso Media also publishes critically acclaimed strategy games like the Tropico series, Railway Empire, Commandos, Port Royale, Dungeons, Sudden Strike, and others for PC, PlayStation®, Xbox®, and Nintendo Switch™. Recent releases include Port Royale 4, Tropico 6 - Nintendo Switch™ Edition, Commandos 2 - HD Remaster, Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale, Railway Empire 2, Dungeons 4 and The Inquisitor. 

***
